question: Indicate which atoms are connected in non-carcinogenic type molecules.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
